load_biencoder_ranker: build a BiEncoderRanker model from a params dict with bert_model, out_dim, and path_to_model keys
encode_context_embeddings: encode context text into dense vector embeddings using the BiEncoderRanker context encoder
encode_candidate_embeddings: encode candidate text into dense vector embeddings using the BiEncoderRanker candidate encoder
score_candidates: score candidate embeddings against context embeddings using dot product or hard negative comparison
train_biencoder: train the BiEncoderRanker by computing cross-entropy or BCE loss on context and candidate pairs
